heuristics.name: none
heuristics.description: No discriminating signal in the options; arbitrary pick.

heuristics.name: pair-coherence
heuristics.description: Two-blank item: pick the pair whose two words relate most naturally (contrast or cause-effect).

heuristics.name: shared-word
heuristics.description: One word repeated across two options marks the key's neighbourhood; pick the coherent one of the two.

heuristics.name: odd-one-out
heuristics.description: Option differing in form (non-alliterative) from three look-alike distractors.

heuristics.name: confusable-pair
heuristics.description: Two lookalike words present; key presumed to be one of them.

heuristics.name: antonym-pair
heuristics.description: Antonym pair present; key presumed to be one of them.
